title: Web UI: status stepper redesign + status history accordion
summary: Pill status stepper (filled=reached/outlined=pending) prominent + separate Status history accordion with the change log + motivation.
description:
Redesign of the status visualization across all 3 detail pages (feature/phase/task). CURRENT STATE (before this phase): - StatusCardStepper (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-card-stepper.tsx) rendered verbose cards with icons + "reached/pending" text labels, perceived as "badges with DONE icon". - In task-detail (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx ~line 128) the stepper was inside a "Status history" subsection (`

Status history

`), not prominent. - feature-detail (route.tsx ~line 92) and phase-detail (route.tsx ~line 111) had the same subsection wrapper. - Phase backbone was ["draft","planned","in-progress","done"] (missing "discovery"). GOAL (user intent): - A compact STEPPER: row of pills `[Planned] → [In Progress] → [Done]` with an icon inside each pill. FILLED (solid status color) = status reached; OUTLINED (transparent, muted) = pending; current status gets a ring. Intermediate visited statuses (blocked, waiting, deferred, canceled, rejected) inserted in chronological position. Placed PROMINENTLY (right after title/description, NOT inside any accordion/subsection). - A separate "Status history" ACCORDION (collapsible `
`) containing ONLY the chronological list of status changes + motivation (statusLog entries: date, fromStatus → toStatus, title, description). This is the audit trail; the stepper is the at-a-glance progress. WORK: - Rewrote status-card-stepper.tsx as pill stepper (icon + label, filled/outlined, current ring, intermediates inserted, terminal non-done replaces done). - New component packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx (collapsible list of statusLog entries with motivation). - task-detail/route.tsx: stepper moved out of Card (prominent, between header and Card); StatusHistoryAccordion added inside Card. - feature-detail/route.tsx: removed "Status history" label subsection; stepper inline; accordion to be added. - phase-detail/route.tsx: same + backbone -> ["draft","discovery","planned","in-progress","done"]. - CSS .status-stepper/.status-pill (reached filled / pending outlined / current ring) in base.css. ALSO PENDING: checklist item number "c" issue — user reports task-detail shows "c" as the item number. Data has number=1..5, render is ["C", i.number]; likely stale served dist. Needs clean rebuild + recopy + user hard-refresh. BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: statusLog-driven reached set; intermediate insertion order; terminal non-done handling; date tooltip on hover.

tasks.title: Status stepper redesign + status history accordion on all detail pages
tasks.description:
Implement the redesigned status visualization across feature/phase/task detail pages.

Code refs:
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-card-stepper.tsx (rewritten: pill stepper, icon+label, filled reached / outlined pending, current ring, intermediates inserted chronologically, terminal non-done replaces done)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/status-history-accordion.tsx (NEW: collapsible `<details>` listing statusLog entries with date, from→to, title, description/motivation)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx (stepper moved prominent outside Card; StatusHistoryAccordion added inside Card after Notes)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/feature-detail/route.tsx (removed "Status history" label subsection; stepper inline; TODO: add StatusHistoryAccordion)
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/phase-detail/route.tsx (TODO: same + backbone → ["draft","discovery","planned","in-progress","done"])
- packages/plan-web-ui/src/styles/base.css (.status-stepper / .status-pill-reached|pending|current rules added)

Steps:
1. Add StatusHistoryAccordion import + element to feature-detail and phase-detail (inside Card).
2. Move phase-detail stepper out of subsection (prominent), fix backbone to include discovery.
3. Verify build + type-check (pnpm check + pnpm -r build).
4. Clean rebuild web-ui + copy-web-ui.sh to fix stale dist (checklist "c" issue: data has number=1..5, render ["C",i.number]; stale served dist suspected).
5. User hard-refreshes browser.

Edge cases: empty statusLog (accordion shows "No status changes recorded"); terminal non-done (canceled/rejected) drops done pill; in-progress current spins its icon.

Behaviors to preserve: statusLog-driven reached set, intermediate chronological insertion, date tooltip, current ring.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented: StatusCardStepper rewritten as pill stepper (icon+label, filled=reached/outlined=pending/current ring, intermediates chronological, terminal non-done replaces done). Stepper moved prominent (outside Card, no label subsection) on task/feature/phase detail. New StatusHistoryAccordion (collapsible statusLog list with date+from→to+motivation) added to all 3 detail pages. Phase backbone now [draft,discovery,planned,in-progress,done]. CSS .status-stepper/.status-pill in base.css. Built + copied to pi-adapter & plan-server web-ui-dist. Committed 52876cd. Checklist 'c' issue diagnosed: CSS is correct (lightningcss split .checklist-num into fallback+@supports+props rules), data has number=1..5, render is ['C',i.number]; root cause is stale browser cache — user must hard-refresh (Cmd+Shift+R) after restart.

---
**Completion summary:**
Removed the cosmetic 'C' prefix from checklist-num render (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx:59): now renders {item.number} only (e.g. "1".."5"), since the C letter was not part of the actual item number agents use. Rebuilt web-ui + copied to pi-adapter & plan-server web-ui-dist (hash index-Clya-kI6.js). User must restart web server (/planner web stop + /planner load) + hard-refresh to see it.

---
**Completion summary:**
Redesigned StatusCardStepper as horizontal node+connector stepper (commit 85e3ca3). COMPLETED steps all green (Check icon) — fixes the 'only last colored' bug by inferring reached from backbone position when statusLog is empty (done task with no log → all steps green). CURRENT = status-color node + ring + static icon (PlayCircle for in-progress, no spinner). PENDING = dashed muted outline. Removed 'C' prefix from checklist-num badge. Responsive. Built + copied to local web-ui-dist AND quick-patched into the npm-installed extension (~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/@agent-plan/pi-adapter/web-ui-dist, hash CVoLlazW) so user sees it without a release. User must restart web server (/planner web stop + /planner load) + hard-refresh.

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit c07f083. Stepper: each step uses its own status color via --step-color CSS var (planned=blue, in-progress=amber, done=green, blocked=red, …); completed+current filled with step color, current adds ring/glow, pending = dashed muted outline with step-color-tinted icon. Removed container background; added inner padding (0.9rem 1rem). Removed Check-icon override — every step keeps its own status icon (PlayCircle static for in-progress, no spinner). Connector colored per destination step. StatusHistoryAccordion now open by default when populated (so from→to transitions are visible immediately). Built + copied to local web-ui-dist + quick-patched npm-installed extension (hash index-D6ijLk-q.js, index.html updated). User must restart web server + hard-refresh.

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit 4db4b5e. StatusHistoryAccordion now infers transitions from backbone+currentStatus+startedAt/completedAt when statusLog is empty (a done task shows planned→in-progress→done, inferred entries tagged). open by default when transitions exist. 3 detail routes pass currentStatus/backbone/startedAt/completedAt. Stepper colors softened: completed/current = soft color-mix tints (14%/22% step color) + muted colored icons, not harsh solid; current soft ring; no container background; connector soft-tinted. Root cause of empty history: pi-adapter task_update doesn't record statusLog (only task_start/complete do) — UI inference covers it. Built + copied + npm quick-patched (index-CF9d0qJa.js). User: restart web + hard-refresh. TODO: make task_update record statusLog on status change (backend fix).

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit a624c59. Status history accordion now renders ONE line per transition: '<date time>: <from> → <to>'. Removed the 'inferred' tag, the duplicate '→ In Progress' title line, and the title/description rows. Backend statusLog recording verified: pi-adapter task_update TOOL (line 3401) and plan-mcp task_update (line 721) and serve.ts PUT (line 647) all record on status change. The interactive /planner task update command (line 1955) does NOT record statusLog — minor, UI inference covers it. Checklist toggle persists checked field, preserves statusLog (round-trip via full-task PUT), does not add statusLog entry (correct — not a status transition). Built + copied + npm quick-patched (index-AE26SABY.js).

tasks.title: pi-adapter-task-006-fix-shortid-ref-resolution
tasks.description:
4 pi-adapter tools (task_update, task_delete, task_start, task_complete) resolve the task ONLY by exact UUID (t.id === params.taskId) but their descriptions promise "5-char shortId, UUID, or title". This breaks shortId/composite/title refs: task_start GTZYV → "Task not found: GTZYV". Fix: replace the UUID-only resolution with findTaskByRef(phases, features, params.taskId) — same pattern already used by task_get (line 3274) and task_checklist_* tools. Keep updatePhase(hostPhase.id, ...) but resolve task by found.task.id (UUID) inside the mutation for robustness.
Also (latent bug, refs.ts core): parseTaskComposite regexes /t0*(\d+)/ /p0*(\d+)/ /f0*(\d+)/ match "t/p/f"+digits ANYWHERE in the string, so a shortId like HT23X (or a title containing t12) would be intercepted as taskNum before the shortId lookup. Anchor the composite match so it only applies to refs that LOOK like composites (contain "/" or start with T/P/F+digits) and do shortId lookup first or restrict regexes.
Files: packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts (lines ~3360, 3420, 3447, 3480), packages/plan-core/src/refs.ts (parseTaskComposite).
Verified read-only before this task: 4 tools UUID-only, task_get/checklist use findTaskByRef.

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit e9b2f85. Fixed 4 pi-adapter tools (task_update/task_delete/task_start/task_complete) that resolved task refs ONLY by exact UUID, breaking shortId/composite/title despite their descriptions promising them. Now use findTaskByRef(phases, features, params.taskId.trim()) — same pattern as task_get (line 3274) and checklist tools. Verified: task_start GTZYV now resolves to "Estrarre HypeLink in packages/ui in una task dedicata (T121)" in the hype plan; 20/20 real shortIds resolve. Also fixed latent core bug in refs.ts parseTaskComposite (unanchored /t0*(\d+)/ regexes matched "t/p/f"+digits anywhere: shortId HT23X was parsed as taskNum 23 → wrong task; P1ID failed). Anchored composite regexes (^F/P/T$, ^P(F)/T$, ^P/T$, ^T$) + early shortId lookup for 5-char refs. 10/10 unit tests pass. Build + check clean (14 findTaskByRef occurrences in dist vs 10 before).

tasks.title: pi-adapter-task-007-fix-phase-feature-ref-resolution
tasks.description:
5 pi-adapter tools resolve their entity ref ONLY by exact UUID while their descriptions promise short refs (F00x, P00x, shortId, title):
- feature_update (line ~2906): updateFeatures(doc => doc.features.find(f => f.id === params.featureId)) — no findFeatureByRef
- feature_delete (line ~2973): doc.features.filter(f => f.id !== params.featureId) — no findFeatureByRef; also uses params.featureId for cascade phase filtering
- phase_update (line ~3149): st.loadPhase(params.phaseId) — loadPhase is UUID-only
- phase_delete (line ~3203): st.loadPhase(params.phaseId) — UUID-only
- task_create (line ~3284): st.loadPhase(params.phaseId) — UUID-only, AND the created task gets phaseId: params.phaseId (the raw ref!), corrupting data

User-reported repro: task_create with 'P018' → 'Phase not found: P018' even though P018 exists (findPhaseByRef resolves it).

Fix pattern (same as already-fixed task tools): resolve via findPhaseByRef(phases, features, ref) / findFeatureByRef (local pi-adapter helper at line ~1197, which supports F00x/shortId/UUID/name) and use the canonical found.id (UUID) for all subsequent operations (updatePhase id, deletePhase id, task.phaseId, feature filtering in cascade).

Files: packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts. Also check plan-mcp for the same pattern (plan-mcp task_create at line ~630 uses findPhaseByRef — verify feature tools there too; plan-mcp findFeatureByRef at line 70 does NOT resolve shortId — same latent bug as pi-adapter had).

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit b74307a. Fixed 5 pi-adapter tools that resolved entity refs ONLY by exact UUID while their descriptions promised F00x/P00x/shortId/UUID/title: phase_update (st.loadPhase UUID-only), phase_delete (same), task_create (st.loadPhase UUID-only AND stored the raw ref as task.phaseId — would corrupt data), feature_update and feature_delete (f.id === params.featureId UUID-only). Repro: task_create with 'P018' → 'Phase not found' even though findPhaseByRef resolves it. Now all resolve via findPhaseByRef (core: UUID/P00x/P00x(F00x)/shortId/title) or an inline feature resolver matching feature_get's pattern, and use the canonical UUID downstream (updatePhase/deletePhase ids, task.phaseId, cascade filtering). Verified: findPhaseByRef resolves P018/P18/shortId/uuid/title (5/5); feature resolver resolves F001/f001/F1/shortId/uuid/name (8/8); e2e task_create P018 → canonical phaseId 'phase-18' saved correctly. Build + check clean.

tasks.title: web-ui-task-005-remove-agent-facing-checklist-notes
tasks.description:
The task detail page in the Web UI shows agent-facing instructional text that humans shouldn't see:
- route.tsx line 167: "Per-task checklist — agents tick steps via planner-task-checklist-toggle (C1/C2 or title), not by writing DONE in titles." (long note aimed at agents)
- route.tsx line 182: "No steps. Add implementation steps via /planner task update (checklist) so they can be ticked individually." (didactic empty state)

These instructions are redundant for agents: they already live in the tool descriptions that agents actually read — pi-adapter task_checklist_toggle description (index.ts:3540) and plan-mcp task_update checklist param describe (index.ts:719). Agents never read the Web UI to learn how tools work.

Fix: remove both texts from packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx, keep "Steps (N)" heading, keep the checklist toggle list, and use a neutral empty-state text (e.g. "No steps defined.") or nothing.

---
**Completion summary:**
Commit 0e188cb. Removed the two agent-facing instructional texts from the task detail page in packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx: the long "Per-task checklist — agents tick steps via planner-task-checklist-toggle…" note (line 167) and the didactic "No steps. Add implementation steps via /planner task update…" empty state (line 182). Kept the "Steps (N)" heading and the checklist toggle list; replaced the empty state with neutral "No steps defined." Agents still read the instructions from tool descriptions (pi-adapter task_checklist_toggle index.ts:3540, plan-mcp task_update checklist param index.ts:719) — the Web UI note was redundant. Grep confirms no remaining agent-facing texts in plan-web-ui/src. Web UI build clean; bundle synced to pi-adapter/web-ui-dist and plan-server/web-ui-dist via scripts/copy-web-ui.sh.

tasks.title: handoff page accordion collapsed by default
tasks.description:
The /handoff page currently renders each pending handoff as expanded, and the long handoff text makes the page hard to scan. Change the Handoff page UI so every listed handoff is wrapped in an accordion that is collapsed by default. Keep the summary row compact (phase ref + first line / timestamp) and reveal the full handoff body only when expanded.

Target file: packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff/route.tsx (and a small helper component if needed). Preserve ordering, preserve the full handoff content when expanded, and keep the page readable on mobile. Do not change the underlying handoff data model or API.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented in packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/handoff.route.tsx. Each listed handoff now renders inside a collapsed-by-default <details> accordion with a compact summary row and expandable full content. Mobile readability preserved; no data-model/API changes.
